correctness.rationale: The directed complete d-cycle of classes forces every walker deterministically through the classes and draws independent uniform vertex labels in each visited class, including time 0. For t+1=qd+s, class j receives exactly M_j=qk+Σ_{a=0}^{s-1}h_(j-a mod d), so the entire cover CDF factors as ∏_j n!S(M_j,n)/n^{M_j}. Coupon completion time is a convolution of independent geometric waiting times with log-concave mass and interval support; summing a log-concave positive mass gives strictly log-concave F_n for indices >=n. Equal-sum balancing therefore increases the product, strictly once all cells have positive occupancy probability and some window spread>=2. Mechanical floor differences telescope to balanced circular s-windows for all s, proving simultaneous stochastic order and the if-and-only-if window criterion. Independent exhaustive rational tests covered n=2,3, d=3,4, k=1..3, all h, many t and direct F_n comparisons. The missing-coupon factorial-moment Poisson limit yields the subsequential Gumbel CDF with λ-weighted window penalties; Jensen gives coefficient>=d. Independent rational occupancy recomputation confirms the incompatible unequal-size best starts at horizons t=3,4. Boundary assumptions of uniformly random initial vertices, identical sizes and integer-time phase are essential.
